Former Delhi Mayor Shakuntala Arya Passes Away at 98

Shakuntala Arya, who served as Delhi's first woman Mayor from the BJP, has passed away at the age of 98. Her death has caused a wave of grief within the party. She was a significant figure in Delhi's political landscape.
